Definition: Mahalalel, the name of an antediluvian patriarch and of an Israelite
BiblicalUsage: Mahalaleel = "praise of God"; 1) son of Cainan and the 4th in descent from Adam in the line of Seth; 2) a descendant of Perez, the son of Judah
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
